interpretation: Different sites, phases, sampling depths and local statistics are preserved separately. No pooled seasonal envelope, basinwide or whole-eddy maxima, simultaneous vertical profile, or shear is inferred. The 45 m September 25 maximum and the final-phase 2.6-knot maximum have distinct sampling support and are not collapsed into a conflict or one depth profile.
